subject: Draft: GCP co-sell playbook & joint pipeline review
content:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@google.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: GCP co-sell playbook & joint pipeline review

Hi Anita and GCP partners —

Thanks again for the intro last week. We've pulled together a first-pass co-sell playbook and would like to align on a short joint pipeline review cadence (biweekly to start) and intake template so we can prioritize the deals that are co-sell eligible. Attached is the draft playbook (v0.9) and a short checklist.

Key asks:
- Can you share the GCP intake template you prefer? (example fields: GCP rep, account MQL/ARR, decision timeline, compliance blockers)
- Do you prefer a biweekly pipeline sync or a monthly exec touch?
- Any pre-reqs we should include for enablement (e.g., marketplace listing milestones, co-marketing approvals)?

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick sync this week to align on the template and who will own each field.
2) We fill in the first joint spreadsheet with 6 priority deals for the pilot.
3) Formalize the playbook and publish to our shared drive.

Attachments: GCP_CoSell_Playbook_v0.9.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

—Camila
Camila Reyes | Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Camila —

Appreciate the draft. Quick answers inline:
- We have a standard intake template; attaching for your team to map to Redwood fields.
- For new partnerships, we recommend a biweekly pipeline touch for the pilot, with a monthly leadership summary.
- Marketplace listing milestones are helpful as a gating criterion (listing complete, 3rd-party review, and billing validation).

I attached the standard template (GCP_Request_Template.xlsx). Can Jonas and Marissa populate the first 6 deals and share the spreadsheet back? Also looping in Daniel Park from our channel partner team — he owns enablement for APAC/NA reseller routes.

Availability: I can do 5/13 10–11am PT or 5/14 9–10am PT.

Thanks,
Anita
